notes: Stop names are the engraved stops. Each stop has three Voice Palette alternatives, and the Organ Type piston switches between American Eclectic, English Cathedral, French Romantic and German Baroque; the Library Access / MIDI controls are not included.

The Solo is a floating division (no keyboard of its own): it is played from the Great or Swell with "Solo on I" / "Solo on II". Its notes are assumed to go out on the Solo channel 16 listed in the owner's manual - check on your organ.
The brochure lists 3 tremulants without naming them; Great, Swell and Solo tremulants are assumed.
MIDI channels: the keyboards always transmit on fixed channels Great 12, Swell 13, Solo 16, Pedal 14, whether or not a Library/MIDI coupler is on. Check on your organ.

Individual stop messages are not published. Pistons send either a Rodgers "STOP MAP" System Exclusive dump or a memory Program Change (set in the MIDI menu). Neither can be mapped to single stops, so every stop is unbound: use Learn every stop. If a stop sends nothing when you move it, it cannot be learned.
The controller sent by the expression shoes is not documented, so no expression mapping is set.
Stop list: https://www.centralmusic.biz/wp-content/uploads/2019/02/Rodgers-Infinity-brochure-2017.pdf (Rodgers Infinity Series brochure 2017, "Stoplist Infinity Series 243", Engraved Stop column)

MIDI scheme: https://www.rodgersinstruments.com/uploads/owners_manual/owners_guides_2017/1905371_H00_INFINITY_ORGAN.pdf (Rodgers Infinity 243/361/484 owner's manual, "About MIDI transmit channels", p. 18 / PDF p. 22: Choir CH15, Great CH12, Swell CH13, Solo CH16, Pedal CH14, fixed)
